title: 9 Warriors

sources.label: BEST Rank Up 9 Warriors Build In Dota 2 Auto Chess

body:
# 9 Warriors

A traditional armour-stacking Warrior board that wins by refusing to die. Warriors
aren't here to deal the most damage — they stack armour and **reflect** incoming
physical damage back at the attacker, so against the many physical builds in the
lobby you often win simply by out-tanking them and letting the reflection do the
work. Doom is the pure-damage carry that closes games the reflection can't, and a
small Naga splash bolts on magic resistance for the mage matchups. The board
spikes at 6 Warriors in the mid game and reaches full power at 9 Warriors from
around round 21.

## Core Units

Early cheap Warriors carry you to 6; the legendary Warriors take over late because
their higher base stats mean more armour and more reflected damage.

| Unit | Cost | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Doom | 4 | Pure-damage carry, holds the best items |
| Primal Beast | 5 | Legendary front-line tank |
| Sven | 5 | Legendary cleave body |
| Troll Warlord | 5 | High-base-stat legendary Warrior |
| Slardar | 3 | Armour reduction |
| Pudge | 3 | Front-line hook |
| Centaur Warrunner | 2 | Stampede enabler |
| Mars | 1 | Early item holder / damage reduction |
| Medusa | 4 | Naga splash for magic resist |
| Tidehunter | 5 | Naga + Ravage (swap for Medusa when found) |

Doom is the priority legendary — easy to find, huge base stats, and his ultimate
does pure damage and shuts off enemy healing and casts. Late, cut the tier-1
Warriors (Tiny, Mars, Axe) for higher-base-stat purples and legendaries, which
tank harder and reflect more.

## Items

Everything funnels onto the front tank early, then onto Doom.

- **Vanguard** on round 3 is the make-or-break early item — the damage block
  roughly doubles a melee board's efficiency. Put it on Mars.
- **Buckler / armour items** on Mars for more reflected damage.
- **Tranquil Boots** on Mars for sustain on the main tank.
- On Doom: **Refresher Orb** (double Doom) and **Vladmir's Offering** for team
  lifesteal aura; **Spell Prism** lets a refreshed Doom hit up to four targets.
- **Giants Ring** on Doom vs Void; **Havoc Hammer / Hex / Scythe of Vice** (tier
  5) are the answers to pure-damage carries and haste mages.

## Relics

- **Magic Seed** works here because Warriors don't roll early — click it before
  the round starts to bank an extra growth of gold.
- **Leafy Essence** is a fine mid-to-late economy relic that also protects health.
- **Stolen Vault** is the safe default when you're spending aggressively and want
  to keep climbing levels.

## Leveling / Roll Plan

This is a **win-streak** build — keep as many Warrior pairs as possible and level
aggressively to 5 after round 6 to stay ahead, since two-star Warriors with
Vanguard rarely lose early. Don't chase interest at the cost of the streak. Build
economy back up around 6 Warriors, then ease to level 9 and roll for two-star
*purple* Warriors — **do not** hyper-roll for three-stars, as overflow, mage
counters, and control all punish it. Hit 9 Warriors from round 21 for the power
spike. From round 26-35, stop rolling blind and instead tech toward whoever is
left: two/four Nagas vs mages, two Stampede (Magnus + Centaur) vs haste mages and
squishy boards.

## Positioning / Matchup Notes

The simplest line is one tanky front unit taking damage with the rest of the
Warriors following up; spread them enough that AoE burst (Elemental shadow-fin,
big nukes) can't delete several at once. Warriors hard-counter physical boards
(reflection) and are one of the few good answers to **Void** — you don't debuff
them, you just out-armour them until they can't hurt you. The dangerous matchups
are **Elementals** (burst that ignores your tankiness — answer with Stampede to
stop the casts), heavy **mages** (splash Nagas), and **pure damage** carries like
a Havoc-Hammer Gyrocopter, which is the hard counter that armour can't stop —
race to a tier-5 item, Hex, or Scythe of Vice for those.
